subject: Mathematics
title: Trigonometric Functions and Equations
summary: Angles are measured in degrees or radians (π rad = 180°). The six trigonometric functions are defined on the unit circle; their signs follow ASTC (All, Sin, Tan, Cos positive in quadrants I–IV).
Identities — compound angle, multiple and sub-multiple angle, sum-to-product and product-to-sum — let you simplify any expression.
Trigonometric equations have general solutions: sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)ⁿα; cos θ = cos α ⇒ θ = 2nπ ± α; tan θ = tan α ⇒ θ = nπ + α.
The range of a sin θ + b cos θ is [−√(a² + b²), √(a² + b²)] — a JEE favourite for maximum/minimum questions.

formulas.name: Basic identities
formulas.formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1;  1 + tan²θ = sec²θ;  1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

formulas.name: Compound angles
formulas.formula: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B;  cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B;  tan(A ± B) = (tan A ± tan B)/(1 ∓ tan A tan B)

formulas.name: Useful products
formulas.formula: sin(A + B) sin(A − B) = sin²A − sin²B;  cos(A + B) cos(A − B) = cos²A − sin²B

formulas.name: Double angle
formulas.formula: sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ = 2 tan θ/(1 + tan²θ);  cos 2θ = cos²θ − sin²θ = 1 − 2sin²θ = 2cos²θ − 1 = (1 − tan²θ)/(1 + tan²θ);  tan 2θ = 2 tan θ/(1 − tan²θ)

formulas.name: Triple angle
formulas.formula: sin 3θ = 3 sin θ − 4 sin³θ;  cos 3θ = 4cos³θ − 3 cos θ;  tan 3θ = (3 tan θ − tan³θ)/(1 − 3tan²θ)

formulas.name: Sum to product
formulas.formula: sin C + sin D = 2 sin((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2);  cos C + cos D = 2 cos((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2);  cos C − cos D = −2 sin((C + D)/2) sin((C − D)/2)

formulas.name: Product of three
formulas.formula: sin θ sin(60° − θ) sin(60° + θ) = ¼ sin 3θ;  cos θ cos(60° − θ) cos(60° + θ) = ¼ cos 3θ;  tan θ tan(60° − θ) tan(60° + θ) = tan 3θ

formulas.name: Range of a sin θ + b cos θ
formulas.formula: −√(a² + b²) ≤ a sin θ + b cos θ ≤ √(a² + b²)

formulas.name: General solutions
formulas.formula: sin θ = 0 ⇒ θ = nπ;  cos θ = 0 ⇒ θ = (2n + 1)π/2;  sin θ = sin α ⇒ θ = nπ + (−1)ⁿα;  cos θ = cos α ⇒ θ = 2nπ ± α;  tan θ = tan α ⇒ θ = nπ + α;  sin²θ = sin²α ⇒ θ = nπ ± α
formulas.mistake: Squaring both sides can introduce extra roots — always check.

formulas.name: Sine and cosine rules
formulas.formula: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C = 2R;  cos A = (b² + c² − a²)/(2bc)

formulas.name: Conditional identities (A + B + C = π)
formulas.formula: tan A + tan B + tan C = tan A tan B tan C;  sin 2A + sin 2B + sin 2C = 4 sin A sin B sin C

examples.title: Product of cosines
examples.solution: Using cos θ cos(60° − θ) cos(60° + θ) = ¼ cos 3θ with θ = 20°: ¼ cos 60° = 1/8 = 0.125.

examples.title: Product of tangents
examples.solution: tan θ tan(60° − θ) tan(60° + θ) = tan 3θ ⇒ tan 60° = √3 ≈ 1.732.

examples.title: Maximum value
examples.problem: Find the maximum value of 3 sin x + 4 cos x.

examples.title: Product of sines
examples.solution: sin θ sin(60° − θ) sin(60° + θ) = ¼ sin 3θ with θ = 10°: ¼ sin 30° = 0.125.

examples.title: General solution
examples.solution: 2(1 − sin²x) + 3 sin x = 0 ⇒ 2sin²x − 3 sin x − 2 = 0 ⇒ (2 sin x + 1)(sin x − 2) = 0. sin x = 2 is impossible, so sin x = −1/2 = sin(−π/6) ⇒ x = nπ + (−1)ⁿ(−π/6), n ∈ ℤ.

topics.title: Radian measure
topics.explain: One radian is the angle subtended at the centre by an arc equal to the radius. Arc length l = rθ (θ in radians). 1 radian ≈ 57°16′.

topics.title: Signs and allied angles
topics.explain: Angles (90° ± θ), (270° ± θ) change sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot; angles (180° ± θ), (360° ± θ) keep the function. The sign is taken from the quadrant of the original angle (ASTC).

topics.title: Graphs and periods
topics.explain: sin x and cos x have period 2π and range [−1, 1]; tan x has period π and range ℝ (undefined at odd multiples of π/2). Period of sinⁿx and cosⁿx is π for even n and 2π for odd n.

topics.title: Strategy for equations
topics.explain: Reduce to one function (using identities), factorise, then apply general-solution formulas. For a cos x + b sin x = c, divide by √(a² + b²); a solution exists only if |c| ≤ √(a² + b²).

topics.title: Sum of sines/cosines in AP
topics.explain: sin α + sin(α + β) + … n terms = sin(nβ/2)/sin(β/2) × sin(α + (n − 1)β/2); a similar formula holds for cosines. Useful for cos(2π/7) + cos(4π/7) + cos(6π/7) = −1/2.

topics.title: Maximum/minimum tricks
topics.explain: For a sin²x + b cos²x the range is between a and b. For expressions like sin x cos x use sin 2x/2. AM ≥ GM helps for sums like tan²x + cot²x ≥ 2.
